name: Arthur Rinderknech
intro: Arthur Rinderknech is a very tall tennis player from France. He is almost two meters high! He went to college in Texas before turning pro.
story: Arthur started tennis lessons at age six. His mom was a pro tennis player too. He did not turn pro right away. First he went to college at Texas A&M. Last year he reached his first giant final in Shanghai. This year he was the No. 26 seed. A seed is a ranking badge for top players. He won two matches in New York. What a run!

funFacts.text: He is 1.96 meters tall. That is about as tall as a refrigerator!
His mom, Virginie, was a pro tennis player on the women's tour.
He has three sisters: Mathilde, Julie and Flore.
He studied business at Texas A&M University in the United States.
His cousin Valentin Vacherot is a pro too. They played together on vacations since age five.
He and his cousin lived across the street from each other in college.
He cheers for the French soccer club AS Saint-Étienne.

watchFor: Look how he towers over almost everyone on court at 1.96 meters tall.

notes: Born 1995-07-23 Gassin, 196 cm, right-handed/2HBH, mother Virginie Paquet ex-WTA pro, three sisters Mathilde/Julie/Flore, Texas A&M, cousin Vacherot, AS Saint-Etienne fan, tennis lessons at age 6, 2025 Shanghai Masters runner-up: confirmed on en.wikipedia.
